_what: Live source for the GoogleTest suite's size and skip set (GitHub #276). Updating this file is how a deliberate change to either is recorded; check_suite_totals.py fails on any drift that has not been recorded here.
_why_a_set: A count cannot distinguish a new skip from a different machine. CI reported 15 and a workstation 19 for the same commit, the difference being four CNN-model tests whose model file is absent locally.
note: Recorded 2026-10-07 from the phase-2 evidence run on this workstation. CI run 37366537472 reported 15 skipped for a comparable commit; the four CNNFontClassifierTest entries here skip because the CNN model file is absent locally, which is why the SET is recorded and not a threshold.
